one_line: Delivered dumbbell set cracked and gouged customer's basement floor; wants floor-repair reimbursement, not a return.
Delivered mechanical keyboard has sticky spacebar; customer wants an in-home repair technician, not an exchange.
Delivered office chair leg snapped causing a fall injury; customer wants a formal safety incident report filed.
Delivered laptop has dead pixels; customer wants a replacement shipped before returning the defective unit (cross-ship).
Delivered notebook's binding fails; customer wants it reported to the manufacturer as a batch defect, no refund.
Delivered coffee maker leaked and warped a countertop; customer wants countertop refinishing reimbursed.
Delivered grill has an active propane leak; customer demands urgent product-safety hazard escalation.
Delivered espresso machine pump is faulty; customer wants a warranty repair technician, not an exchange.
Delivered vacuum cleaner smoked and smelled of burning plastic; customer wants a fire-hazard report filed.
Delivered security camera gave customer a mild electric shock; wants a product safety incident reported.
Delivered bicycle has cracked frame welds before a race; customer wants a replacement shipped before returning it.
Delivered smartphone arrived shattered in a crushed box; customer wants to file a claim with the shipping carrier.
Delivered wristwatch stopped keeping time; customer separately wants the manufacturer warranty period extended.
Delivered electric toothbrush overheated and scorched a bathroom counter; wants hazard report plus damage reimbursement.
Delivered smart watch is the customer's second defective unit; wants a supervisor and formal quality complaint, not another return.
Delivered patio umbrella collapsed and cracked a car's rear windshield; customer wants the repair cost covered.
Delivered LED bulb shattered during install and cut customer's hand, needing stitches; wants to file an injury claim.
Delivered portable charger started smoking near papers on a desk; customer demands urgent fire-hazard escalation.
